scope: Backend/domain MVP. No frontend changes; approved Stitch images still need authorized materialization and inspection.

authorization.staffAccess: Existing global StaffAuthGuard admin-only default. No MER, BA, Sales or other role grants added.
authorization.draftStorage: In-memory request/result only; no database persistence.

endpoints.authority: caller_attested_snapshots: inputs are not fetched or independently verified by this endpoint
endpoints.semantics: complete means calculation inputs were complete for this preview; activationAllowed is always false
supported: One SKU-scoped fixed, percentage, tiered or BOGO value
Uncapped or known remaining mechanic units
endpoints.rounding: Josh's existing resolved-unit rounding first; preview line, cost and tax totals half-up to satang. Nominal engine total and unit-rounding adjustment are exposed. Fractional-measure line/tax policies remain preview policies, not a new checkout contract.
unsupported: Supplier/retailer prices or current metadata treated as actual cost
Historical COGS or actual net profit
endpoints.missingData: Missing, stale, mismatched or unversioned required inputs never become zero cost/stock or an activation-ready result. Unsupported data produces incomplete/rejected with reason codes.

endpoints.input: Stable Josh order UUID only; no caller-supplied URL, source, SQL, table or credential
endpoints.semantics: Policy thresholds guide review, not proof of an SLA breach or a certain business failure. Suggestions name the admin role; they do not assign an owner.
sources: Read-only Josh replica orders and existing paidOrderSql predicate
jagota_order_sync_history using stable attempt/order/shipment IDs, source_version and imported_at
endpoints.boundedScopes: At most 100 sync rows and 100 stock lines; fetch 101 to flag truncation. Partial scopes are explicit.
supportedFindings: Per-shipment latest failed or overdue pending sync attempt
Settled status without successful payment evidence
Recorded stock-deduction shortfall or returned deduction for a settled order
limits: Compares Josh order identity to its Commerce copy; core platform orders are a different scope
Source change time is unavailable in these schemas; read time cannot restart grace
Replica lag from Josh primary is not measured
A newly read sync row retains its original imported_at
Missing sync attempt has no known paid/send due time
Recorded deductions are not live inventory availability
Shipping deadlines and repack costs are not inferred
No automatic retry, resend, copy, inventory adjustment, customer message or repair

nextIntegrations: Map authorized real selling-price and stock snapshots with explicit UOM, tax, capacity and freshness provenance.
Provide an effective-dated authoritative cost source; current buying_price metadata is insufficient. Until then real cost/margin remains unavailable.
Retain preview requests/results as a reviewed proposal only; any persisted draft storage is a separate contract.
Add source-change/event time and approved milestone deadlines for meaningful lag grace and overdue shipping rules.
Render the approved Stitch surfaces only after actual image bytes are inspected; preserve welcome-lead-email and existing ACLs.
